🚴♂️ ZNH 750W 26-inch Shimano 7-speed electric bike
Adult electric mountain bike / electric cruiser / off-road electric bike
Welcome to ZNH Electric Bike Store! Explore our high-performance electric bikes, whether it is off-road or wilderness adventure, this model can easily handle it. Equipped with a powerful 750W brushless motor and 48V 13Ah battery, it can reach a maximum speed of 25 miles/hour (about 40km/h) and a range of up to 70 miles (about 112 kilometers), making every ride faster, farther and less labor-intensive.
7-speed Shimano transmission system, 5 riding modes and front suspension shock absorber, adapt to various terrains and easily switch riding rhythms. Equipped with dual disc brakes, adjustable seat height and LCD display, it ensures a safe, comfortable and smooth riding experience. Integrated LED headlights and bells are clearly visible day and night to ensure the safety of every trip.
